review.notes: No code fences in the OCR source; headings and tables are structurally intact, and the appendix computer-use examples are image embeds with their prompt text inside the images. Word-level diff of extracted text from all 14 physical pages against the OCR markdown; the PDF text layer carries U+200B instead of printed hyphens, so dropped-content transcription was done from 300 dpi renders (footnotes 1-3). Remaining diff lines are hyphenation artifacts, chart-internal labels of Figures 1-2 and page numbers. Tables 3-8 values spot-checked against the print; Table 8's i/ii footnote lines were already present. The print's own misspelling 'capabilites' is restored, not corrected.
